text: Let us recap. Diffraction is the spreading of waves at openings comparable with their wavelength. A single slit gives minima at a sine theta equals n lambda, and a central maximum two lambda D over a wide, so a narrower slit spreads the light more. Interference and diffraction are both superposition, but they differ in their sources and their patterns. A grating gives sharp maxima at d sine theta equals n lambda. And by Rayleigh's criterion, a telescope resolves one point two two lambda over a, so bigger is better.
